notes.title: Game development is completely over!
notes.notes:
Thank you all for the feedback, we have implemented all the features and fixed all the bugs and problems that players have encountered. There is no new content planned for this game,[b] but we are already making a new game that will be more detailed and bigger.[/b]

Subscribe to our Steam page and social network to know about our new games!

notes.title: Update mouse sensitivity and screen mode settings!
notes.notes: We noticed that some users had problems with mouse sensitivity, so we completely reworked the logic of camera movement. We also added in the settings the possibility to change full screen mode to windowed mode and vice versa, because some players asked for it.

notes.title: Improved glow and added some explanation.
notes.notes: Improved the glow on 1 location. Added explanation of the progress reset button
